title: Steak ’n Shake Adds $10 Million in Bitcoin to Corporate Treasury
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Steak ’n Shake Adds $10 Million in Bitcoin to Corporate Treasury Steak ’n Shake says they added $10 million worth of bitcoin to their corporate treasury. This post Steak ’n Shake Adds $10 Million in Bitcoin to Corporate Treasury first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
